_source: Deterministic parse of raw Telair PBX CSV exports (ExportCallRecords, InboundCalls_Detailed, CallQueue_Detailed per queue) via scripts/parse_call_logs.py, chained against assets/data/reports/2026-10-20/call-logs.json. Replaces this date's earlier PDF-text-extraction of this same file (committed under this date previously) now that the raw CSVs are available. See _summaryVsGrandTotalNote and _outboundDurationNote for the handful of verbatim-recorded gaps found against the earlier PDF reading.
_summaryVsGrandTotalNote: This file's own summary (from the deduplicated InboundCalls_Detailed file: 271 total/228 accepted/43 missed) reads 1 OVER the previously-committed PDF-derived figure for this date (270 total/227 accepted/43 missed). The extra accepted call is CallGUID a5db4704-770a-4c5b-9ec6-52de8de7dba0, 7:53:53 AM, 15 sec, answered in 6 sec under CallAlertName 'Denman - Rec 1' — a direct reception-line extension, not one of the four named call queues, so it never appears in any CallQueue_Detailed file. inboundByStaff's own total (228) matches this file's summary exactly, confirming the gap sits in the queue-level breakdown, not the staff/summary read. The queue-level grandTotal (from the four named queues only) sums to 227 accepted/43 missed (270 total) and matches every one of Appointments/General Enquiries/Canberra Vasectomy/Health Professionals' own previously-committed PDF figures exactly — the earlier PDF-only reading of this date apparently never captured 'Denman - Rec 1' calls either (absent from its own inboundByStaff table), so this is newly-surfaced data from the raw CSV, not a new inconsistency. All figures recorded verbatim rather than reconciled to agree.
_tenDayTrendNote: accepted/missed/answerRatePct/overallAvgWaitSec all chain-match 2026-10-20's own committed trend exactly at positions 0-8. Position 9 (today): missed (43), answerRatePct (84%) and overallAvgWaitSec (52) all match the previously-committed PDF-derived figures for this date exactly; accepted (228) is 1 over the PDF-derived 227 — see _summaryVsGrandTotalNote for why ('Denman - Rec 1', a direct-line call absent from the PDF's own staff table).
_queuesNote: accepted/missed/avgWaitSec for all four queues chain-match 2026-10-20's own committed data exactly at positions 0-8, and all three non-zero queues' accepted/missed/avgWaitSec at position 9 match the previously-committed PDF-derived figures for this date exactly (Appointments 140/23, 54 sec; General Enquiries 79/20, 49 sec; Canberra Vasectomy 8/0, 37 sec) — clean match, no queue-level gap this date (the one new inbound call found this run was a direct-line extension call, not a queue call — see _summaryVsGrandTotalNote).
_patientServiceKpiNote: All figures (longestCallDurationSec/At/Agent, longestWaitingTimeSec/At, avgCallHandlingSec) and the full longestWaitPerQueue table match the previously-committed PDF-derived figures for this date exactly — clean independent confirmation of that earlier reading.
_staffCountNote: inboundByStaff carries 12 names this run, one more than the 11 on the previously-committed PDF-derived table — the extra name is 'Denman - Rec 1' (1 call, 0 min), a direct reception-line extension call the PDF's own printed staff table never captured (see _summaryVsGrandTotalNote). Every one of the other 11 names matches the PDF-derived table exactly on both calls and duration.
_outboundDurationNote: outboundByStaff's own call counts match the previously-committed PDF-derived 11-name outbound staff table exactly for every name (45/20/20/18/17/10/4/3/2/1/1, summing to the confirmed 141-call total, which also matches this file's own summary.totalOutbound exactly). Per-agent durationMins differ from the PDF-derived figures for most names (Apurva Pathak 57 here vs 66 there, Rebecca Quinn 21 vs 24, De Ang Renfree 26 vs 31, Lucinda Gonzalez 18 vs 21, Pinky De Paz 9 vs 14, Andrew Davies 9 vs 11, Shae Connors 3 vs 4, David Antioch 2 vs 3; Emily Pettett, Lyneham - Rec 1 and Holly Archer match exactly) — consistent with each source rounding individual call durations to the nearest minute before summing in a slightly different way, not a data error; recorded verbatim rather than adjusted to match.

_outboundOtherExtensionsNote: Not available in the earlier PDF-only extraction of this date (that report printed only the one reception-team outbound page) — this raw parse adds it fresh: 110 calls across direct room/doctor/nurse extensions, on top of the 141 reception-team calls in summary.totalOutbound, for 251 total outbound calls across every extension today.
_outboundTenDayTrendNote: FLAG FOR USER REVIEW (ninth consecutive date with a divergence on this chart): positions 0-8 chain-match 2026-10-20's own committed trend exactly (268, 200, 235, 172, 105, 160, 158, 219, 241). Position 9 (today) is this file's own raw-CSV-derived all-extensions total: 251 (141 reception + 110 other) — independently computed, not taken from the PDF's own chart, which instead printed 163 for today (an 88-call gap). summary.totalOutbound (141, reception-only) remains independently confirmed via the raw CSV's own reception-staff breakdown, which matches the PDF-derived staff table exactly on call counts.
